title: 第6章  双喜临门啊！重新入伍！
slug: 四次入伍我被军区拉进黑名单
content_zh:
林毅抬眸对视，点头反问：“你是李舒婉？”
“嗯。”
李舒婉淡淡应声，没有多余的寒暄，姿态优雅的落座。
“想喝点什么？我请。”林毅本着礼貌，率先开口询问。
这次退伍回来，退伍费加上日常的津贴都没有上交家里。
当然，家里也看不上这一笔小钱，就留着给他花了。
别说请个咖啡了，就算是把咖啡厅买下去……他也不会买，因为买完就没钱了个屁的。
可话音刚落，就被李舒婉直接打断。
她抬眼看向林毅，直白道：“不用了，我今天过来不是来相亲的，只是想当面把话说清楚。”
她微微端坐，清冷道：“我目前没有谈恋爱和结婚的打算，也不想通过联姻、相亲安定下来。”
“这场相亲，我本身就不同意，只是碍于家里长辈的安排，不得不过来一趟。”
“所以很抱歉，大概率会耽误你的时间。”
“回去之后，我会主动跟家里说明是我个人原因，不愿成婚，与你无关，你那边也可以直接归咎于我，不用有任何顾虑。”
听完这番话，林毅瞳孔微亮。
卧槽？天降助攻！
他正愁找不到合理的理由推掉相亲，正纠结怎么应付家里的施压，没想到对方竟然跟他是同一个想法！
而且这女人也太有分寸了，主动揽下所有责任，太好了！
这波简直正合他心意，完美符合他的要求啊！
林毅语气格外爽快：“太好了！实话实说，我也是这么想的！”
他一秒都不想多待，当即利落起身：“既然我们想法一致，那咱们就好聚好散，互不耽误。”

“很高兴认识你，李小姐，祝你往后顺遂，再见！”
话音落下，他没有半分留恋，转身抬脚就走。
李舒婉端坐在原位，清冷高傲的表情僵在脸上。
她怔怔地看着林毅毫不犹豫、渐行渐远的挺拔背影，大脑短暂空白。
良久，足足愣了十几秒，李舒婉才缓缓回过神来。
她微微蹙眉，心底莫名涌上一股微妙的憋屈感。
明明是她先开口拒绝相亲，明明是她率先表明不想结婚、主动终止这场相亲。
可为什么到头来，她却有一种……自己被火速、干脆、毫不留情地单方面拒绝了的错觉？
甚至对方的喜悦都快溢出来了，仿佛能顺利结束这场相亲，是捡了天大的便宜一样？
她……就这么被拒绝了？
第二天清晨，天刚蒙蒙亮。
六点整，林毅双眼睁开，立刻清醒。
他侧头瞥了眼床头柜的手机，屏幕刚好亮起，六点整。
这是刻在骨子里的生物钟，六年军旅，六年三进三出，确实不是一两天就能改过来的。
林毅抬手揉了揉眉心，满脸生无可恋：“服了，在家也六点准时醒，老子这是，彻底变成部队的形状了是吧？”
他躺在床上，被子一盖就想继续睡。
可就算是闭上眼睛，却也根本睡不着，甚至还产生了一种负罪感。
就好像继续躺下去，就是对自己不负责一样……
“妈的！”
林毅一掀被子，立刻起身活动了下身体。

刚想开门出去吃早餐，他转头看了眼床铺，顿时浑身难受，脸色也格外的别扭。
被子歪歪扭扭堆在床头，床单皱皱巴巴、乱七八糟，枕头随意丢在一旁，松松散散毫无章法。
他攥紧拳头，一脸便秘的样子：“我他妈的……”
半小时后。
原本乱糟糟的床铺焕然一新。
床单平整紧绷，没有一丝褶皱，边角利落分明，即便是家用的被子被他叠得有模有样，虽然达不到棱角分明，近乎标准的豆腐块那样，却也有了些许模样。
这已经是能做到的极限了。
看着整洁利落的床铺，林毅这才舒坦了，但也更难受了。
“终究是变成部队的形状了，已经……已经变不回来了！”
餐厅里，一家三口早已落座。
林毅不紧不慢的走出房间，踩着拖鞋走到餐桌前。
父亲林国栋端坐在餐桌旁，面色沉沉，一言不发。一旁的爷爷林建军，更是脸色铁青，眉眼间满是不悦，周身气压低得吓人。
自从他昨天回来之后，家庭氛围就没好过。
林毅已经习以为常了，脸上半点波澜没有，依旧是那副吊儿郎当的模样，自顾自拉开椅子坐下，拿起碗筷就干饭。
王秀兰看着自家儿子，眼神关切：“小毅，怎么起这么早？今天又不用出操不用训练，好不容易在家，怎么不多睡会儿？”
现在的年轻人都流行睡懒觉，她还以为儿子第一天回来，肯定会睡到日上三竿再起来。
哪怕是起来了也肯定要在床上躺着。
却没想到竟然会出来吃早餐。
“睡不着了。”
林毅扒了一口粥，随口敷衍，语气散漫，“到点就醒，躺着反而浑身别扭，正好今天我也有事，要出去一趟。”

林国栋和老爷子全程冷脸沉默，就仿佛他不存在一样。
林毅心里门儿清，这两位大佬还在为昨天的相亲事件闹别扭呢。
昨天相亲结束，他回家如实交代，说是女方李舒婉率先表明态度，无意相亲、不想结婚，全程只是配合家里走个过场，两人和平散场，半点纠葛没有。
可偏偏不管他怎么解释，家里这两尊大佛就是死活不信。
在他们眼里，他向来随性叛逆、爱折腾，铁定是他当场摆烂、甩脸拒婚，把好好的一门亲事作没了。
任凭林毅怎么辩解，两人一概不听。
林毅心里也是无奈得很，属实没辙。
不信就不信吧，他懒得再多费口舌解释。
反正相亲黄了是事实，对他来说就是天大的好事，只要能阻止他安家安稳，只要能给他重返部队留机会，被误会两句也无所谓。
一顿早饭吃得安安静静，无人搭话。
快速吃完早饭，林毅放下碗筷，擦了擦嘴，起身就回房换了一身干净的休闲便装。
不顾客厅里两位长辈依旧阴沉的脸色，他揣着口袋，脚步松弛，潇洒出门。
下楼之后，他顺路在小区门口的便利店买了两箱纯牛奶，单手轻松提着，不慌不忙朝着不远处的烟城一中走去。
老爷子跟老爸想让他成家立业、安稳度日，彻底断了入伍的念头？
这次说什么都要回部队去，天王老子也拦不住我，我说的！
不过，现在退伍已成定局了，暂时没法直接归队，那他就换条路走。
复读、考本科、走大学生征兵渠道。
他了解过政策，24岁还想要入伍当兵的话，就只有两条路，一条考学，一条特招。
而特招的要求很高，必须掌握相应的技术要求，例如导弹维修，或是某些特种职业的专业类人才。
林毅当了六年兵，一直都是义务兵，基本的军事素质不在话下，但技术……他会个毛的技术啊！

所以，他毅然决然的选择另一条路，考学！
他只要能如愿考上本科，那么征兵年龄可以放宽到24岁，而他今年刚好24岁。
毕竟，在参军入伍前，他最好的成绩可是班级前十，如果不是当年被家里管的太严而产生了厌学心理，考上军校都不是没可能的事。
当然，如果今年不行，那就彻底没戏了。
除非他能在明年考上本科，然后用一年时间考上研究生，才能赶上研究生征兵的条件，年龄放宽到26岁。
但这条路，可比考本科难多了，容错率也低的可怕。
不管怎么走，考本科都是第一选择。
而今天，他就是来烟城一中办理复读入学手续的。
content_en:
Ji Yi raised his eyes and looked at each other, nodded and asked, "Are you Li Shuwan?"
"Yeah."
Li Shuwan responded calmly, without any unnecessary greetings, and sat down gracefully.
"What would you like to drink? I'll buy it." Ji Yi was the first to ask out of politeness.
This time when I came back from the army, my retirement pay and daily allowances were not handed over to my family.
Of course, the family didn't like this small amount of money, so they kept it for him to spend.
Not to mention buying a coffee, even if he buys the coffee shop... he won't buy it, because after buying it, he will have no money.
But as soon as he finished speaking, he was directly interrupted by Li Shuwan.
She raised her eyes to look at Ji Yi and said bluntly: "No, I'm not here for a blind date today. I just want to make things clear in person."
She sat upright slightly and said calmly: "I have no plans to fall in love or get married at the moment, nor do I want to settle down through marriage or blind dates."
"I personally don't agree with this blind date. It's just that due to the arrangements of the elders in the family, I have to come over."
"So I'm sorry, it will most likely delay your time."
"After I go back, I will take the initiative to explain to my family that it is my personal reason and my unwillingness to get married has nothing to do with you. You can also blame me directly without any worries."
After hearing these words, Lin Yi's pupils brightened slightly.
Damn it? Assistance from heaven!
He was worried that he couldn't find a reasonable reason to turn down the blind date, and was struggling with how to deal with the pressure from his family. He didn't expect that the other party had the same idea as him!
Moreover, this woman is so measured and takes the initiative to take on all responsibilities, which is great!
This wave is exactly what he wants and meets his requirements perfectly!
Ji Yi's tone was particularly refreshing: "Great! To be honest, I think so too!"
He didn't want to stay for a second longer, and stood up immediately: "Since we have the same idea, we can get together and go away without delaying each other."
"Nice to meet you, Miss Li. I wish you all the best in the future. Goodbye!"
After the words fell, he didn't miss him at all, turned around and walked away.
Li Shuwan sat in her original position, with a cold and arrogant expression on her face.
She stared blankly at Ji Yi's tall back, which was moving away without hesitation, and her mind went blank for a moment.
After being stunned for a long time, which lasted for more than ten seconds, Li Shuwan slowly came back to her senses.
She frowned slightly, feeling a subtle sense of frustration welling up in her heart.
It was obvious that she was the first to refuse the blind date, and it was obvious that she was the first to express that she did not want to get married and took the initiative to terminate the blind date.
But why in the end, she had the illusion that... she was unilaterally rejected quickly, simply, and without mercy?
Even the joy of the other party almost overflowed, as if being able to end this blind date smoothly was a huge advantage?
She... was rejected just like that?
The next morning, it was just dawn.
At six o'clock sharp, Ji Yi opened his eyes and woke up immediately.
He glanced sideways at the cell phone on the bedside table. The screen just turned on at six o'clock.
This is a biological clock engraved in the bones. Six years of military service, six years of three in and three out, it is indeed not something that can be changed in a day or two.
Ji Yi raised his hand and rubbed the center of his brows, with a look of despair on his face: "I'm convinced, I'll wake up at six o'clock on time at home. I've completely transformed into a soldier, right?"
He lay on the bed and wanted to continue sleeping as soon as the quilt was covered.
But even if I closed my eyes, I couldn't sleep at all, and I even felt guilty.
It's like continuing to lie down is irresponsible to yourself...
"Damn it!"
Ji Yi lifted the quilt and immediately stood up to move his body.
Just as he was about to open the door and go out to have breakfast, he turned his head and glanced at the bed. He suddenly felt uncomfortable all over and his face looked particularly awkward.
The quilts were piled crookedly at the head of the bed, the sheets were wrinkled and messy, and the pillows were thrown aside, loose and disorderly.
He clenched his fists and looked constipated: "What the hell..."
Half an hour later.
The originally messy bed had a new look.
The sheets are smooth and tight,There are no wrinkles at all, and the corners are sharp and clear. Even the household quilt is folded by him in a decent way. Although it is not as sharp and angular as a standard tofu block, it still has some appearance.
This is the limit of what can be done.
Looking at the neat and tidy bed, Ji Yi felt comfortable, but also felt even more uncomfortable.
"After all, it has turned into the shape of a troop. It has...cannot be changed back!"
In the restaurant, a family of three had already taken their seats.
Ji Yi walked out of the room unhurriedly and walked to the dining table in his slippers.
Father Lin Guodong was sitting at the dining table, his face was solemn and he said nothing. Grandpa Lin Jianjun on the side was even more livid, his brows and eyes were full of displeasure, and the air pressure around his body was frighteningly low.
Since he came back yesterday, the family atmosphere has not been better.
Ji Yi was used to it, and there was no trace of emotion on his face. He still had the carefree look on his face. He just pulled out his chair and sat down, picked up the bowl and chopsticks and started to cook.
Wang Xiulan looked at her son with concern in her eyes: "Xiao Yi, why did you get up so early? There is no exercise or training today. You are finally at home, why don't you sleep more?"
Nowadays, it is popular for young people to sleep in. She thought that her son would sleep until three o'clock in the morning on his first day back.
Even if you get up, you must still lie down on the bed.
But I didn't expect to come out for breakfast.
"Can't sleep."
Ji Yi took a mouthful of porridge and said casually, with a casual tone, "I'll wake up when the time comes. I feel awkward lying down. It just so happens that I have something to do today and have to go out."
Lin Guodong and the old man remained coldly silent throughout the whole process, as if he didn't exist.
Lin Yi knew very well that the two big guys were still arguing about yesterday's blind date.
After the blind date ended yesterday, he went home and told the truth, saying that the woman, Li Shuwan, was the first to express her attitude. She had no intention of going on a blind date or getting married. The whole process was just a formality to cooperate with the family. The two broke up peacefully without any dispute.
But no matter how he explained it, the two giant Buddhas at home just refused to believe them.
In their eyes, he had always been casual, rebellious and troublesome. He must have ruined a good marriage by showing off on the spot and rejecting the marriage.
No matter how Lin Yi tried to argue, neither of them listened.
Ji Yi felt very helpless and had no choice.
If you don't believe it, don't believe it. He didn't bother to explain it any more.
Anyway, it is a fact that the blind date ended, and it is a great good thing for him. As long as it can prevent him from settling down, as long as it can give him a chance to return to the army, it doesn't matter if he is misunderstood.
The breakfast was quiet and no one spoke.
After quickly finishing his breakfast, Ji Yi put down his bowls and chopsticks, wiped his mouth, got up, and went back to his room to change into clean casual clothes.
Despite the still gloomy expressions on the faces of the two elders in the hall, he walked out casually with his pockets in his pocket and his steps relaxed.
After going downstairs, he stopped by the convenience store at the entrance of the community and bought two boxes of pure milk. He easily carried it with one hand and walked calmly towards Yancheng No. 1 Middle School not far away.
The old man and his father wanted him to start a family, live a stable life, and completely give up the idea of ​​joining the army?
This time I have to go back to the army no matter what, even the King of Heaven can’t stop me, I said so!
However, now that retirement is a foregone conclusion, and he cannot return to the team directly for the time being, he will find another way.
Repeat your studies, take undergraduate exams, and go through college recruitment channels.
He understood the policy. If he still wanted to join the army at the age of 24, there were only two ways, one was to take the exam, and the other was to be recruited through special recruitment.
The requirements for special recruitment are very high, and you must master the corresponding technical requirements, such as missile maintenance, or professional talents in certain special occupations.
Lin Yi has been a soldier for six years and has always been a compulsory soldier. His basic military qualities are not a problem, but his skills... he knows very little about them!
Therefore, he resolutely chose another path and took the exam!
As long as he can get admitted to the undergraduate program as he wishes, the age of recruitment can be relaxed to 24 years old, and he happens to be 24 years old this year.
After all, before joining the army, his best score was among the top ten in his class. If he hadn't been too strict with his family and developed a dislike of studying, it would have been possible to get into the military academy.
Of course, if it doesn’t work this year, it’s totally out of the question.
Unless he can get admitted to the undergraduate program next year and then take one year to get admitted to the postgraduate program, he will be able to meet the requirements for postgraduate recruitment, and the age will be relaxed to 26 years old.
But this path is much more difficult than taking the undergraduate exam, and the error tolerance rate is also horribly low.
No matter which way you go, getting an undergraduate degree is your first choice.
Today, he came to Yancheng No. 1 Middle School to complete the admission procedures for repeat studies.
